title: Top rope climbing
comment: Top roping can be done with the belayer at the top of the climb, enabling more than "half rope" ascents. Also deleted sentence saying top roping is not free climbing, since this is only true if the climber is supported by the rope. This is no different from lead climbing, where a climber can hang on the rope at the last point of protection. In both cases aid is possible, which negates the "free ascent". The only difference is MORE aid is possible when top roping.
